summary: Keep full conversation history and native profile continuity while streaming cold JSONL parsing, retaining parsed histories by estimated message memory, and caching validated record digests with file-state invalidation. Show chat-open, account/provider switch and session-start waits; preserve editable drafts and hold send during a switch.

storageDataMigration.reason: Both caches are bounded and process-local. No schema, stored transcript, paging cursor, persisted setting, or payload changes. Full histories remain available to search and fork. File size, mtime, ctime, inode and device are checked before reuse; changing reads are not cached.

automated: Synthetic 83,950,584-byte Claude JSONL with 1,126 turns, 3,379 records, large tool outputs, images and a compact boundary. Direct history and transcript/profile preparation benchmarks use the real SQLite schema with synthetic rows; no real transcript or account CLI.

JSONL cache tests cover append, rewrite/replacement with restored mtime, truncation, deletion, source/path separation, a changing read, count eviction, large ignored tool results, and event-loop yielding. Transcript tests retain divergence, invalid/incomplete records, concurrent modifications and source-only settle retries.
RN component tests assert wait/error rendering; the RN Jest suite and TypeScript check pass. Android coordinator tests assert the destination account, held sends and retained draft; 53 tests pass.

Desktop wait store tests cover overlapping opens and error retention. Screens-only background visual checks exercise loading, profile switch in chat/picker and startup on a delayed demo IPC handler, including a retained draft and a 100 ms loader visibility assertion.
Final foreground root gate: npm run typecheck and npm test -- --maxWorkers=2 passed (534 files, 5,807 tests, four skipped); build:fast and deslop lint passed.

Eighteen new Darwin wait screenshots were inspected across dark, light and translucent themes. Existing PNG changes were restored. Both final SB_E2E_BACKGROUND=1 SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens comparison runs passed without snapshot updates.
notExercised: No live account rotation, sign-in, provider CLI or SDK startup against credentials. Stop/restart continuity and source-settle retries are covered by fake-adapter and filesystem tests; real provider startup latency remains outside the benchmark.

No physical phone/iOS simulator visual verification. RN spinners are native ActivityIndicator; Android uses existing InlineStatus and its platform animation behavior. Native Android has no cross-provider switch control, so its existing account switch is the affected wait.

No release publication. Desktop/headless changes use the existing build lane; RN changes are JS-only and eligible for the existing fingerprint-compatible OTA lane; Android ships in its existing APK lane. No identity, signing, deep-link, channel or API compatibility changes.

No paging or incremental append parsing was introduced. Very large individual JSON records still parse atomically; directory discovery and the SDK resume migration retain their existing synchronous metadata/copy behavior.
The synthetic database has a single conversation family. Per-family message/enrichment query fan-out and large rotated families remain unmeasured; all measured lookup plans use indexes.
